pages.text: Upon consumption, grants the eater:$(br)$(li)90 seconds of The Pale Messenger and Nourishment$(br2)Permanently grants one chest slot.$(br)Eating raw or cooked cod within the following 20 minutes grants 3 minutes of Resistance IV and Regeneration V.
The divine power of the Nether Cult has many uses—for one, after enjoying a true feast of the gods your heart grows broader and your worries fewer.
